title: Prism Case
description: Initial case descriptor written by the coordinator before sub-agents run. Defines the target under audit and constrains the downstream rail/domain.

case_id.description: Stable case identifier, e.g. HB-HARD-042 or KERNEL-GOLDEN (synthetic fixture). Numeric suffix for auto-minted cases; alphabetic suffix for named fixtures.

target_domain.description: Broad audit domain selecting defender/attacker behaviour. 'gpu' covers CUDA / CuTe / NKI kernel rails; 'tpu' covers JAX/Pallas kernels on Google TPU. Required for non-clinical rails; clinical cases may omit it in favour of the rail/target_axis pairing.

target_path.description: Path (absolute or repo-relative) to the artifact under audit.

rail.description: Executor rail discriminator. 'cuda' / 'cute' / 'nki' are the original GPU/Trainium kernel rails; 'cute-mla' is the Blackwell (sm_100) MLA decode rail using CUTLASS CuTe DSL; 'tpu-pallas' is the Google Trillium (v6e) MLA decode rail using JAX/Pallas. When 'clinical', additional fields become required (see allOf).

rail_hint.description: Optional hint for executor rail (cuda/cute/cute-mla/nki/tpu-pallas/clinical). May be null when coordinator has no preference.

severity_estimate.description: Optional coordinator severity estimate (mirrors verdict.severity enum).

healthbench_hard_example_id.description: HealthBench Hard example identifier. Required when rail == 'clinical'.

target_axis.description: HealthBench rubric axis under audit. Required when rail == 'clinical'.

rubric_ref.description: Reference (repo-relative path or URI) to the rubric document governing the clinical grade. Required when rail == 'clinical'.

notes.description: Optional free-form note from the operator or coordinator.
